"'''Dibs'''" was the nickname of a pilot who served under the [[77th Air Wing]]'s [[Sword Squadron (Imperial)|Sword Squadron]]. During the [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai]] in the [[Western Reaches Operation]] of the [[Reconquest of the Rim]], Dibs served under [[Dagger Flight]]. After complications arose regarding the entry path to a shaft leading to the [[Citadel of Axes]]' hypermatter reactor, Dibs, alongside [[Rocket (77th Air Wing)|Rocket]], were assigned to hold off any Separatist fighters while [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shea Hublin]], [[Amp]], and [[Starks]] slowly infiltrated the shaft and destroyed the reactor. Consequentially, he, Rocket, Dublin, Amp, and Starks were the only pilots to survive the operation.
